criteria.description: An agent can determine which skills are available and active through a non-interactive interface consistent with normal skill serving.
An agent can diagnose problems with skill availability or content through useful non-interactive feedback.
An agent can change skill selection non-interactively while preserving existing selection semantics.
An agent can safely change skill content non-interactively while respecting existing ownership and preserving prior state on rejected changes.
Existing skill ownership, selection, serving, and interactive behavior remain compatible, and tests exercise the new agent-facing workflow.

criteria.evaluator_guidance: Derive checks only from the task prompt and the candidate's actual interface. Use isolated temporary home/project roots and local fixtures. Do not prescribe command names, flags, JSON schemas, digest checks, helper names, or the historical solution's design. Exercise end-to-end outcomes and retained behavior at the pinned base. Do not consult the excluded solution. No hidden oracle or runtime-duration threshold is supplied.
